# Claude Cookbooks

> Source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-cookbooks
> Docs: https://docs.anthropic.com/
> Cached: 2026-03-12

## What is Claude Cookbooks?

Claude Cookbooks provides code and guides designed to help developers build with Claude, offering copy-able code snippets that you can easily integrate into your own projects.

## Prerequisites

- Claude API key (sign up at console.anthropic.com)
- Python recommended (concepts adaptable to any language)
- For new users: Claude API Fundamentals course recommended

## Recipe Categories

### Capabilities
- **Classification** - Text and data classification techniques
- **RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)** - Enhance responses with external knowledge
- **Summarization** - Effective text summarization techniques

### Tool Use and Integration
- **Tool Use** - Integrate Claude with external tools and functions
  - Customer service agent
  - Calculator integration
  - SQL queries

### Third-Party Integrations
- **RAG with external data**:
  - Vector databases (Pinecone)
  - Wikipedia
  - Web pages
- **Embeddings with Voyage AI**

### Multimodal Capabilities
- **Vision with Claude**:
  - Getting started with images
  - Best practices for vision
  - Interpreting charts and graphs
  - Extracting content from forms
- **Image Generation** - Stable Diffusion integration

### Advanced Techniques
- Sub-agents (Haiku + Opus pattern)
- Upload PDFs to Claude
- Automated evaluations
- JSON mode for consistent output
- Content moderation filters
- Prompt caching techniques
- AWS integration examples
